fields.name: target_containers
fields.description: Ordered list of container positions [y, x], one per cube named in the goal instruction, in the order the goal names them; each entry is the position, at the last demonstration frame, of the container that ends up hiding that cube. Filled at the first decision step from the demonstration (cube positions in the early frames; at the frame containers first appear, each named cube's container is the one nearest that cube; after that the demonstration is a sequence of shuffles, each a run of consecutive frames in which exactly two containers are away from their resting spots while all others stay put, ending at the frame where all containers rest again, and at the end of every shuffle those two containers have exchanged resting spots; the tracked container is followed by resting spot only, shuffle by shuffle in order: if its spot is one of the two vacated in a shuffle it ends on the other vacated spot, otherwise it keeps its spot). Never changes afterwards; copied unchanged at every later step. e.g. [[81, 90], [87, 134]]

fields.name: put_down_count
fields.description: Number of containers the robot has picked up and then put down so far in this episode. 0 at the first decision step; increases by one at the decision step whose execution steps show the fingers reopening (from about 46% back to about 100%) while over a container, i.e. the step right after a 'put down the container' subgoal finished. e.g. 1
